visualCharacteristics: Stacked campaign cards, each a content panel (headline, lede, CTA) beside an art-directed image; image side alternates from the second card on.
contentPattern: One row per card: h3 title, lede paragraph, CTA paragraph (italic link = secondary) | desktop image (>= 1200px) | optional mobile image. One image alone is used at all widths. Section heading is default content.
usage: Alternating image-and-text campaign features on homepage and landing pages.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for zig-zag media/text feature lists. Use feature-xf for a single full-width banner.
